data.summary: Business Analyst with 7+ years of experience in delivering data-driven insights to support executive decision- making. Certified MBA in Finance, with a strong background in Product Development (SDLC) and experience as a Senior Business Analyst at FIS Global, specializing in the Capital Markets sector. Expertise in Trade Lifecycle, Trade Surveillance, Regulatory Reporting, and Portfolio Management. Proven experience at BNY Mellon as a Business Analyst, specializing in Payment Processing Applications for SWIFT payments, wire transfers, and related processes. Skilled in client-facing roles, collaborating with global clients to deliver Business/IT solutions, application customizations, BRDs, FRDs, Confluence, UAT and training. Proficient in Waterfall and Agile methodologies, MySQL, Jira, and ServiceNow. Hands-on experience with financial instruments, trading platforms like Front Arena, and developing weekly/monthly reports. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Senior Business Analyst FIS Global – Pune, India Product: FIS Protegent Market Abuse Surveillance/Trade Surveillance Custom Development & Upgrade Projects (Clients: Degiro, LBP_BPE)
01/2023 - Current
Led requirement gathering sessions to develop custom alerts using questionnaires and focus groups.  Debugged and resolved client queries related to alert generation, ensuring timely issue resolution.  Analyzed client data to provide business-level justifications and insights.  Led gap analysis and technical planning, driving business process improvements.  Designed and developed client-specific custom alerts tailored to business needs.  Conducted UAT and efficiently resolved client-specific alert issues.  Implemented MIFID-II regulatory changes for all alerts.  Demonstrated strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and communication with stakeholders.
Onboarding & Migration Projects (Clients: Lloyds, Mirae, DABM, Wells Fargo)
Migrated MSM product from SQL to Snowflake/AWS, redesigning architecture and updating business logic for alerts.
 Onboarded new clients, providing walkthroughs and demonstrating market manipulation techniques.  Conducted gap analysis for business-level alerts and ensured smooth client transition/implementation.  Led weekly client and governance calls for project updates and progress discussions.
 Coordinated UAT post-migration, ensuring business requirements and client sign-off.  Developed ad hoc/periodic reports, assisted with hierarchy, workflows, and role setup.  Debugged and troubleshot issues in SQL/Snowflake during data migration and integration.
Onboarding Customers on Best Execution Module (Clients: RDBN, ETCB, WDCO)
Led onboarding for new customers on the Best Execution module, implementing alerts (VWAP, Route Speed, Trade Price Continuity) to enhance execution monitoring and transparency. Addressed client queries, ensuring smooth adoption and understanding of the module.
Agile & SDLC Expertise
Extensive experience in Agile frameworks (Kanban, Scaled Agile) and SDLC phases (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment).
Senior Analyst BNY Mellon – Pune, India Payment Processing & System Management: Managed Deal Manager for SWIFT, wire transfers, and ACH transactions, ensuring seamless and compliant payment processing. Maintained system uptime and ensured adherence to AML and KYC standards. Issue Resolution & Escalation: Troubleshot and resolved payment discrepancies using CSM tools. Acted as the primary contact for document discrepancies, coordinating with internal teams, clients, and banks for swift issue resolution. Payment Instruction Management: Monitored payment instructions and deadlines, ensuring timely execution and proper handling of client documents. Reporting & Documentation: Generated reports to track payment issues, providing insights for decision-making and reconciliation. Maintained up-to-date, accurate payment documentation. Stakeholder Communication & Coordination: Coordinated with internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and resolution of payment-related concerns.
12/2021 - 12/2022
Financial Analyst Real Team Systems Pvt. Ltd – Aurangabad, India Financial Statement Reconciliation: Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial statements through detailed reconciliation, resolving discrepancies across records. Quarterly Earnings Analysis: Analyze quarterly earnings of Fortune 500 companies (NYSE/NASDAQ), benchmark performance, and provide insights to improve forecast accuracy. Revenue Forecasting: Enhance revenue forecasting models using historical data and market trends, improving accuracy by comparing actual vs. forecasted results. Weekly Financial Reporting: Prepare and present weekly financial reports to stakeholders, highlighting trends, outlooks, and deviations to support informed decision-making.
08/2018 - 11/2021
Finance Intern Stock Holding Corporation of India Limited – Aurangabad, India
05/2017 - 07/2017
Analyzed financial performance, identified investment opportunities, and pitched clients on various financial products (e.g., Fixed Income, Bonds, Mutual Funds, Stocks), while assisting in forecasting, risk assessment, and providing improvement recommendations for a boutique investment firm.
